facts.fact: Camtel's Zamengoé data centre near Yaoundé is certified Tier III by the Uptime Institute and offers cloud services, with more than a hundred public and private bodies hosting their data there, per Camtel's director general and panel on 9 June 2026.

CMR.note: Local hosting is described as a goal and a benefit of the data centre; no rule requiring data to stay in the country is stated.

facts.fact: The article says the Zamengoé data centre lets Cameroon meet the strengthened requirements of the law on the protection of personal data.
Camtel says its Zamengoé data centre guarantees local hosting of sensitive national data, and that more than a hundred public and private administrations host their data there.

CMR.note: Document mentions citizens being identified only in passing; no national ID system is stated.
The data centre's ISO 27001 certificate is a certificate and places nothing.

facts.fact: Camtel's Zamengoé data centre is certified Tier III by the Uptime Institute and hosts more than a hundred public and private bodies, by Camtel's account.
The Zamengoé data centre is operated by Camtel, Cameroon Telecommunications, and described by its director general as an exclusively Cameroonian foundation for public data.
More than a hundred public and private administrations host their data at the Camtel Zamengoé data centre, which the article presents as serving government action.

CMR.note: Document states nothing about a national standards body or national standards.
